summary: Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol keeps some shared state between its two ends, such as sequence numbers on the control connection. When one side fails, a new control connection is created, and this extension lets the endpoints exchange information so the new one can be tied to the old one. It is not a full replacement for mirrored state, just an aid to recovery.

eli5.summary: If a phone call drops, this helps both people quickly remember where they left off when they call back, instead of starting from scratch.

questions: how does l2tp recover from a control connection failure
